title: Fatality Animation inspired by Mortal Kombat
author: MrChisaki
selftext: Wondered how Astra would fare making a fatality animation like Mortal Kombat. Astra did the modelling, rigging, coding, basically everything. I just inputted text. I think it turned out not too bad? Could be used in a game

comments.author: dev_D_
comments.body: I dont know if anyone else feels this way but the lack of facial expressions and robotic reactions from that character made me slightly uncomfortable.

replies.author: MrChisaki
replies.body: Yeah AI still has quite a ways to go for this haha, now I'm curious if it can rig emotions. It already struggled quite a big rigging the arms and stuff. Astra is pretty creative though, I'll give it that

comments.author: Covoh
comments.body: You should make a cozy competitive cooking game and if the player loses the host kills them like in the animation. Just keep it a surprise though.

replies.author: dapperdave
replies.body: If OP doesn't, I will, and I'll call it "Do you smell what's cooking?"

replies.author: MrChisaki
replies.body: Now THAT'LL go viral. I like your thinking my friend!
